PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 18.06.2025
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

1. Description of the Servitude.– Acquisition of servitude right over an allotment of land for the Laying of Transmission Pipe Lines to the Kolongaswatta Service Reservoir of Kundasale Haragama Water Supply Project.

2. Description of the Land.– All that allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Maha/KND/2023/10 dated 28.02.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Kengalla, in No. 701, Ihalawela Grama Niladhari Division, in Udagampaha Korale Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kundasale, in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kolongahawatta – Extent: 0.0139 Hectares North: Kolongahawatta claimed by D.G.M.U.D.S. Dolahamuna and road; East: Kolongahawatta claimed by D.G.M.U.D.S.Dolahamuna; South: Kolongahawatta claimed by D.G.M.U.D.S.Dolahamuna and road; West: Kolongahawatta claimed by D.G.M.U.D.S.Dolahamuna.
K.D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/357.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.9th April, 2025.
